scope: frozen-checkpoint mechanistic gradient audit; no optimizer and no parameter updates

configuration.readout: k=0 final source EOS and final target EOS
configuration.mse: mean((z_source-z_target)^2), symmetric unless branch-specific VJP is zeroed
configuration.sigreg: validated exact LeJEPA Epps-Pulley statistic; 17 knots, 1024 fixed seed-533 slices, source/target views independently averaged
configuration.target_partition: per-reaction causal target positions, including EOS, assigned by floor(3*rank/length)
configuration.model_mode: train for gradient checkpointing; all Dropout and attention_dropout disabled
